item.title: Williamson County Library Branches To Close Dec. 12 For Staff Development
item.description: All Williamson County Public Library branches will be closed on Friday, December 12, 2025, for staff development, according to Volunteer and Outreach Coordinator Deborah Reschke. Locations will reopen for normal hours, weather permitting, according to their schedules as listed on the library system website: https://wcpltn.org/101/Branches.
